title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
blurb: Aligned GPT-3 with user intent through supervised fine-tuning, a reward model trained on human rankings, and PPO against that reward with a KL penalty.
intro: The recipe has three stages. Supervised fine-tuning on demonstrations gives a starting policy; a reward model learns from human comparisons of sampled responses; and reinforcement learning maximises the learned reward while a KL penalty keeps the policy near the SFT model and a pretraining term limits regressions. The steps build the SFT loss mask, preference-data cleaning, the Bradley-Terry reward loss, KL-regularised rewards and an RLHF PPO step; the capstone runs the reward-model and RL stages end to end on a toy problem with exact expectations.

steps.name: PPO step with a reference-policy KL
